```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


```{python}
# Learn morea about Code Cells: https://quarto.org/docs/reference/cells/cells-jupyter.html

# Include and execute your code here
df = pl.read_csv("names_year_csv.csv")
```


_The usage of the name Elliot hit a peak between the first and second releases of E.T.. Then it dropped down for a bit, but drastically increased after the third release around 2002._

```{python}
labels = labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of Babies", title = "Babies Named Elliot")
line_color = geom_line(color = "blue")
no_commas = scale_x_continuous(format = "d")
first_release = geom_vline(xintercept = 1982, color = "red")
second_release = geom_vline(xintercept = 1984, color = "red")
third_release = geom_vline(xintercept = 2002, color = "red")

ggplot(df.filter(pl.col("name") == "Elliot").select(pl.col("name"), pl.col("year"), pl.col("Total")), aes(x = "year", y = "Total")) + theme_gray() + line_color + no_commas + labels + first_release + second_release + third_release
```
